# obot Provider

Connects to Obot using an API-scoped key. Set `OBOT_BASE_URL` and obtain `OBOT_TOKEN` with `export OBOT_TOKEN="$(obot login --scope api --print-token)"`. Explicit provider configuration takes precedence over environment variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "obot" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Obot app URL or API base URL. Falls back to `OBOT_BASE_URL`. A trailing `/api` is added when omitted.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Obot API key with API access. Falls back to `OBOT_TOKEN`. Obtain it with `obot login --scope api --print-token`.
